note: Every lint exemption this repo carries on 2026-09-15: 10 eslint-disable/-line/-next-line/-enable directive comments across backend/src and frontend/src, plus 3 ignores-glob entries across the two flat eslint.config.mjs files (bundling 8 individual globs after dist-e2e joined frontend's), and zero rules pinned to 'off' in either config. Each entry's reason was written after reading the code around its key, not invented. The ratchet is two-directional: a new exemption not listed here fails scripts/verify/ratchets/lint-exempt.mjs, and a listed entry whose exemption no longer exists in the tree fails it too — this file may only shrink or be re-dated by a reviewed change, never grow by drift. Two entries were RE-KEYED on 2026-09-15 rather than added: both are the same exemptions this file already carried, whose line numbers moved under main's merge.

entries.reason: sharp ships ESM-style type defs (export default) over a CJS runtime whose module.exports IS the factory; with this project's esModuleInterop off, a default import would resolve to undefined at runtime, so the runtime factory is bound via require() instead, typed against sharp's own default export.

Mirrors the require() workaround documented in image-processing.ts: sharp's CJS export cannot be default-imported without esModuleInterop, and this spec needs a live sharp instance to synthesize a JPEG fixture carrying EXIF GPS data for the metadata-stripping test.
Same sharp CJS-vs-ESM require() workaround as image-processing.ts, needed here only to build a JPEG fixture buffer for the media service's own upload tests.

TypeORM's QueryDeepPartialEntity<T> cannot accept a plain object for the jsonb `before` column, so only this one field is cast through any; casting the whole insert() payload instead would also suppress key-checking on action/actor_id/target_type/target_id, where a typo needs to stay a compile error.

Same jsonb-cast rationale as line 47, for the `after` column: QueryDeepPartialEntity<T> rejects a plain object there too, and casting only this field keeps the sibling keys in the same insert() call checked against AuditLog's real shape.

Opens a block-scoped disable for the ResizeObserverStub class immediately below, whose constructor/observe/unobserve parameters are intentionally unused — kept only so the stub's signature mirrors the real ResizeObserver and a caller passing the required arguments still type-checks.

Closes the block-scoped disable opened at line 36 right after the ResizeObserverStub class, so no-unused-vars is back in force for the rest of this file instead of staying off for every line that follows it.

The test writes `false && 'b'` as a literal constant expression on purpose, to prove cn() drops a falsy argument; the rule exists to catch an accidental always-true/false condition, which is exactly what this assertion needs to be for the test to mean anything.

The restore effect is meant to re-run only when storageKey changes; methods, opts and lastPayloadRef are all read through stable refs (latest.current, lastPayloadRef.current) rather than closed-over values, precisely so they do not belong in the dependency array.

URL.createObjectURL is an impure, one-shot browser call that must run in an effect, and the setObjectUrl that follows it is a genuine external-system side effect the rule's derived-state heuristic does not fit; image-picker.test.tsx verifies this stays correct under StrictMode's double-invoke.
Build output and third-party dependencies must never be linted — dist/ is compiled output regenerated on every build and node_modules/ is vendored code this repo does not own or want flagged.

Scopes the money-arithmetic ban (no *, /, Number(), toFixed, parseInt, parseFloat) away from the money modules' own test files, which legitimately use plain-number arithmetic to build fixtures and assert on money.ts's rounding rather than reimplementing it. Re-keyed 2026-09-15: the exemption itself is unchanged, its LINE moved 44 -> 70 when main's cash, point-cash, cash-counts and intake-top-ups slices grew the `files` list above it from four module globs to eight — exactly the line-number sensitivity this row's own blindSpot names.

Build output, third-party dependencies and the Vitest coverage report are generated or vendored, never source this repo authors, so there is nothing for the linter to usefully check there. `dist-e2e` was ADDED 2026-09-15 and is not cosmetic: it is the `smoke` row's own --outDir (e2e/constants.ts's E2E_OUT_DIR), gitignored but invisible to eslint's flat config, which does not read .gitignore — so the first `npm run verify:full` left a minified bundle on disk and the next `npm run verify` reported 2116 lint errors inside it, a false red measured on exactly that sequence.
